list.heading: Heading above the member list in the left rail, e.g. 'Members (3)'. PLURAL on {count} — Polish needs three forms. {count} is already formatted by n(). CSS uppercases it, so give sentence case. Glossary: member/user → użytkownik. Replaces a heading that was split into a word plus a separate '(n)' node.
list.new: Icon button above the member list, and the action inside the empty state. Opens the create dialog. Imperative or noun phrase, ≤3 words — it is also the button's aria-label and title.
list.unsaved: aria-label and title of the small • dot marking a member with unsaved role changes. The dot itself stays in markup. ≤2 words.
list.noRoles: Shown under a member's email when no role is assigned to them. Not an error. ≤2 words.
list.editAria: aria-label of the pencil button on a member row. {email} is that member's address, so the label is unique per row.
list.deleteAria: aria-label of the bin button on a member row. {email} is that member's address, so the label is unique per row.
list.selfDeleteHint: title of the bin button when it is disabled because the row is the signed-in operator's own account. Says why it cannot be used. No trailing period.
detail.created: Line under the member's email in the detail pane, giving the day the account was made. {date} is rendered by d() into its own markup node, so the message must have exactly one {date} slot. ≤3 words plus the value.
detail.self: Marker appended to that line when the selected member is the signed-in operator. The · separator stays in markup. ≤2 words. Polish must stay impersonal — no 'Ty'.
detail.rolesHeading: Small heading above the role grid in the detail pane. Noun, plural, 1 word. CSS uppercases it.
detail.roleCount: Fraction next to that heading: how many of all defined roles this member holds. ONE message — never split the fraction. {assigned} and {total} are both numbers; PLURAL on {total}, so Polish needs three forms. Glossary: role → rola.
detail.assignAll: Text button that grants the member every defined role. Imperative, ≤2 words.
detail.removeAll: Text button next to it that takes every role away. Imperative, ≤2 words. The · between them stays in markup.
detail.noRoles: Shown instead of the role grid when the install has no roles at all yet. One short sentence.
detail.save: Primary button at the bottom of the detail pane; commits the pending role assignments. Imperative, ≤2 words. Was Title Case ('Save Changes') before the migration.
empty.noneTitle: Empty-state title when the install has no members besides none at all. ≤3 words.
empty.noneMessage: Body under it. One sentence saying what adding a member achieves — access to the CRM. Polish stays impersonal.
empty.selectTitle: Empty-state title in the detail pane when members exist but none is selected. ≤3 words.
empty.selectMessage: Body under it. One sentence telling the reader to pick a row on the left, and what they can then do (manage roles).
edit.action: Label of the pencil action: its title attribute, and the heading it is not — see edit.title. Imperative, ≤3 words.
edit.title: Title of the edit dialog. Polish is a noun phrase ('Edycja…'), English an imperative — a heading, not a button. ≤3 words.
edit.description: Sub-title of that dialog. {email} is the member being edited and must be wrapped in the locale's own quote marks (Polish „…”, English “…”). It replaced " entities in the old template.
edit.newPassword: Field label for the optional replacement password in the edit dialog. ≤2 words.
edit.passwordHint: Hint under that field: an empty value means the password is left alone. One sentence.
create.title: Title of the create dialog. Polish is a noun phrase, English an imperative. ≤3 words.
create.description: Sub-title of that dialog. Two short sentences: what is created, and that roles come afterwards. Polish stays impersonal — no 'You can'.
create.password: Field label for the starting password in the create dialog. 1 word.
create.submit: Submit button of the create dialog. Imperative, ≤3 words.
form.email: Field label for a member's email address, in both dialogs. 1 word.
form.emailPlaceholder: Placeholder in both email inputs — an example address, not a real one. Keep the reserved example.com domain and localize only the name part. The @ MUST be written as {'@'}: a bare @ is vue-i18n's linked-message syntax and fails to compile.
form.emailRequired: Validation error shown under the email field when it was left empty. One sentence.
form.passwordHint: Hint under the password field of the create dialog. {min} is the minimum length. One short sentence.
form.passwordPlaceholder: Placeholder inside both password inputs. Same intent as form.passwordHint but no trailing period. {min} is the minimum length.
form.passwordMin: Validation error when the typed password is too short. ONE key for both dialogs, and the same wording in both. {min} is the minimum length — never write the number into the message.
delete.action: Label of the destructive action: the bin button's title, and the confirm button of its dialog. Names the action AND the object — never a bare 'OK'. Imperative, ≤3 words.
delete.title: Title of the delete confirmation. A question, ≤4 words. Polish uses the infinitive ('Usunąć…?').
delete.message: Body of that confirmation. {email} identifies the member and must be wrapped in the locale's own quote marks. Say that the action cannot be undone.
discard.title: Title of the confirmation shown when unsaved role changes would be lost — on switching member, and on leaving the page. A question, ≤3 words. Polish uses the infinitive.
discard.one: Body of that confirmation when switching to another member. {email} is the member whose edits are pending, wrapped in the locale's own quote marks.
discard.all: Body of the same confirmation when navigating away from the page entirely, where no single member can be named. Polish stays impersonal — no 'You have'.
discard.confirm: The confirm button of that dialog. Names what happens: the edits go away. Imperative, ≤3 words.
toast.saved: Toast after the pending role assignments were stored. Past tense, ≤3 words.
toast.added: Toast after a new member was created. Past tense, ≤3 words.
toast.deleted: Toast after a member was removed. Past tense, ≤3 words.
errors.load: Error banner above the whole page when the member list could not be fetched. {message} is the server's own reason, inserted into the sentence — keep it as one message, never as fragments around the value.
errors.save: Fallback in the save toast when the server gave no message. No trailing period.
errors.create: Fallback in the create dialog when the server gave no message. No trailing period.
errors.delete: Fallback in the delete toast when the server gave no message. No trailing period.
errors.reasonUnknown: Used as {message} in errors.load when the failure carried no server text at all. A sentence fragment that has to read naturally after a colon — lower case, no trailing period.
